items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Of course, Benny Goodman is very good friends with Paul.

ctx.x: We were talking about the OK date then. Harry's New Yorker.

Well, I mentioned Jess Stacy was on piano. In fact, Paul recommended Jess Stacy to Benny Goodman. And that's where Jess went into Ben Goodman for Paul's recommendation. Of course, Benny Goodman is very good friends with Paul. In fact, Benny played for Paul's wedding when he was in short pants. Really? Yeah, Benny was only at that time 16 years old.
I met Paul's wife. She was the brother of some police captain or something? Yeah, her brother Tom was captain of police
